notes.title: An Important Update on the Development Status of Sealed Souls
notes.content:
Hello everyone following Sealed Souls,
This is DesignK.
Today, with a heavy heart, I need to share a difficult decision regarding the development progress of Sealed Souls: I will be temporarily pausing the development work on this game.
As a solo indie developer, my time and energy are very limited. Recently, to concentrate all my resources and ensure that my other interactive narrative game, 《攻略那个男人》(Gong Lue Na Ge Nan Ren / "Target: Him" - Translator's Note: Provide an official English title if you have one, otherwise this placeholder or a short description is needed), which I'm currently pouring all my effort into, can be successfully completed and reach the quality I envision, I had to make this tough choice.
I know this news might be disappointing for those who have been looking forward to Sealed Souls, and for that, I am truly sorry. Sealed Souls is a project I've poured a lot of heart and ideas into – the fantasy world I wanted to build, the combat feel and exploration I wanted to create. Pausing its development was not my intention, but rather a difficult necessity due to current circumstances.
I remain passionate about the world of Sealed Souls and sincerely hope that after completing 《攻略那个男人》 (the other game), or at some suitable time in the future (when I have more resources or time), I can return to this world and continue this sealed adventure. However, at this moment, I cannot provide a definite timeline for resuming development.
The Steam store page for Sealed Souls will remain up, but there won't be any substantial content updates in the near future.
If you're interested in my new project, the narrative game 《攻略那个男人》 (the one about interacting with a girl from another world via a terminal), feel free to check that one out – it's where all my focus is right now.
Finally, thank you again to everyone who has wishlisted Sealed Souls, left comments, or simply followed the game quietly. Thank you for the anticipation you've shown, and thank you for your patience and understanding now.
Sincerely,
